_about: PoC-2 test fixture. A deliberately messy family exercising the three hard layout cases. Generation/layer is NOT stored — the layout must derive it.

_hardCases.remarriage: Idi (p1) partners Rama (s1), then remarries Zara (s2) — one person in two unions.
_hardCases.halfSiblings: Ali & Hawa (Idi+Rama) vs Bina (Idi+Zara) share only one parent.
_hardCases.cousinMarriage: Ali (grandchild via Idi) marries Sala (grandchild via Nana); both descend from Abou+Fati -> a diamond at their son Umar, plus a cross-family edge that stresses crossing minimization.
